caption: The drawing features a single object, an urn-shaped lidded vessel rendered in pencil on a light beige background. The vessel is symmetrical and centrally positioned, with a rounded body that tapers inward toward the base and a pedestal foot that sits on a rectangular platform. The lid is domed, topped by a finial that is bulbous with a small spherical tip. Decorative elements include a scalloped line beneath the rim and an oval medallion with ornate scrollwork on the front of the body. The shading suggests a metallic surface with gradations of light and dark. There is a thin, hand-drawn rectangular border framing the entire composition. The artist's signature, "V. Carano," appears in the lower right corner within the border. The overall color scheme consists of varying shades of gray on a warm, slightly yellowed paper.
title: Silver Sugar Urn
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
